title: Before the Year Turns
caption:
Before the Year Turns

Somehow, it is already late November.
In a little over a month, a new year begins.

In Japan, the first of January is something special —
a true turning point.
As autumn cools toward winter,
a reflective mood settles in.
How was this year? What comes next?
Many women begin to make quiet promises:
to try something new, to take better care,
to become a little more beautiful.

I am one of them.
I worked hard this year; next year, I want to enjoy more.
Or perhaps I felt time on my skin,
and decide to give beauty more attention.
I believe these moments, returning each year,
are what keep a woman's sense of beauty alive.

So I am looking back,
and wondering what life, and what beauty,
I want to enjoy next.

How was your year?
